svg.title: Stamina / Recovery
svg.desc: Stamina recovered per minute, including Mastery. The vertical axis is logarithmic. This is a rate, not time to refill a separate Reserve build. Trait values use a logarithmic horizontal axis. Mastery is included in the no-direct-grants series. Each grant series adds only its named grant.
svg.text: Stamina / min · log scale · higher is better
